items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Eubie Blake crowned me King of Boogie-Woogie

ctx.x: No, no, you didn't tell me about that.

The Crawdaddy, you know, that was just a place with 35 people eating in a room and Musak. It was formerly the room where Guy Lombardo played and I went in there, and inside of one year they would bring one hundred and seventy-five dinners... Eubie Blake...they had a big birthday party...they had a big celebration there and Eubie Blake crowned me King of Boogie-Woogie. He said...when he came in, he says, "Sammy," and he put the crown on my head, "I crown you King of Boogie-Woogie. But I don't kiss men."…

But the guy that's the operator would be listening to modern musicians some and you know, and didn't hire me, but I would come, and they would think...because the man that owned that Popcorn Club said that I was the only one that at 2 o'clock, when the place was closing, the place was still packed and they were demanding encores. And those were his exact words.
